title: Measuring Whether Misaligned Models Have Higher Confidence (Lower Entropy) on Misaligned Outputs

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Understanding the confidence profile of misaligned outputs informs detection strategy but is somewhat indirect. The connection from output entropy to a practical safety tool requires additional work.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Only requires running inference on existing misaligned and baseline models and computing token log-probabilities. No training needed. Standard HuggingFace APIs expose log-probs. Accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Inference-only with two models on the same evaluation set. Single deliverable: entropy/probability comparison. Well-scoped for 30 hours.
